explication: LuaTools is a Windows WPF client for browsing and installing Steam manifest/Lua configurations, managing Steam-side modes and launch options, and installing a companion Steam store-page plugin. The principal workflow runs from the desktop views and view models through manifest job creation and the download queue to installation in Steam. The graph also preserves the documented mode, launch-option, and plugin capabilities. Relationships use README statements or SOURCE INDEX references; unsampled features are shown without invented internal call paths.
